## Motivation

Part 5 of the SAIL upstreaming series, following [2/N] [#43826](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43826) (platform support), [3/N] [#45946](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45946) (fa3 + flashmla) and [4/N] [#47588](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47588) (DeepGEMM GEMM/MoE).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This branch is stacked on #47588's head.** Until #47588 lands, the diff shown here also carries its 76 files; once #47588 merges into `main`, GitHub recomputes the base and this PR shrinks to the 23 files it actually touches. Review it together with #47588 and merge it second. If #47588 goes in as a squash, the top five commits need one more rebase onto the new `main` before this PR's diff collapses.

T-HEAD SAIL ships `pla`, a PPU linear-attention kernel library in its own wheel. Every recurrent step the KDA / GDN paths need exists there as a single fused kernel, but none of it is reachable from SGLang:

- GDN and KDA recurrent decode run the Triton kernels (`fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_update` and the packed `..._k_last_packed` variant). PLA exposes the same math in one call with the KDA gate lower bound folded in, and accepts the width-major conv pools PPU keeps.
- KDA prefill/extend goes through the kernel dispatcher's FlashKDA slot. On SAIL that slot has no fused implementation, and the prefill default never selected it; on top of that the mamba track path asked for per-chunk states unconditionally, which is the one thing a PLA-style extend kernel cannot emit.
- KDA speculative verify/commit (ReplaySSM) has no fused path for the state pool PPU allocates, so the accepted window is folded and the conv rolled back by a chain of Triton scatters. On HGGC that chain also faults: a combined `&` bounds check is not lowered into real branches, and a masked load without `other=` lets masked-out lanes touch out-of-range addresses.
- Kimi-K3's fused decode is hard-coded to the CUDA TP8 layout (12 local heads, `A_log.numel() == 12`), so a PPU TP layout never qualifies.
- Under `--disable-overlap-schedule`, `--mamba-radix-cache-strategy auto` decided "not paged" for a FlashMLA hybrid model, because the mamba pass runs before the pass that snaps the page size to 64.

This PR wires those kernels in behind one gate and leaves the community Triton kernels as the fallback for every batch PLA cannot take.

## Modifications

### 1. The gate and the dependency

- `srt/environ.py`: declares `SGLANG_SAIL_PLA` (`EnvBool(False)`), the only PLA knob in this PR.
- `srt/arg_groups/platform_hook.py`: `handle_sail_backends` probes `import pla`. Present and not explicitly set, the gate turns on, so PLA is the default on a SAIL install. Missing, it logs a warning and forces the gate off, because a PLA-less PPU install is a supported setup. An explicit `SGLANG_SAIL_PLA=0` opts out everywhere.
- `pyproject_other.toml`: adds `pla` to the `srt_sail` extra.

### 2. The vendor code lives under `hardware_backend/sail/`

Six new modules plus a package `__init__`; nothing existing moves.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `srt/hardware_backend/sail/kernels/kda.py` | The only place that imports `pla`. Wraps fused decode, recurrent decode/verify, packed decode, FlashKDA-style prefill and the DSpark MTP kernel, and owns the coverage predicates. |
| `srt/hardware_backend/sail/attention/kda_triton.py` | `SailTritonKDAKernel`: `packed_decode` / `decode` / `target_verify` redirected to PLA, falling back to `super()` per call. |
| `srt/hardware_backend/sail/attention/gdn_triton.py` | The same three slots for GDN. |
| `srt/hardware_backend/sail/attention/kda_flashkda.py` | `SailFlashKDAKernel`: same extend contract, PLA launch, and the CUDA-only sequence-length window dropped. |
| `srt/hardware_backend/sail/attention/kda_backend.py` | `SailKDAKernelDispatcher`, `SailKDAAttnBackend`, and the per-runner `sail_pla_prefill_default`. |
| `srt/hardware_backend/sail/attention/gdn_backend.py` | `SailGDNKernelDispatcher`, `SailGDNAttnBackend`. |

Each kernel falls back to the inherited community implementation when `SGLANG_SAIL_PLA` is off or the batch does not fit the operator, so a SAIL run with the gate closed behaves like upstream.

### 3. Community files keep only subclass hooks

- `srt/layers/attention/linear/kda_backend.py`: the fused-decode call becomes `_fused_decode_covered` / `_run_fused_decode` instead of an inline block, and a new `needs_intermediate_states()` decides whether an extend batch needs per-chunk states (see section 5).
- `srt/layers/attention/linear/kernels/kda_flashkda.py`: the operator call is extracted into `_launch_fused`, so a subclass replaces only the launch. `_should_fall_back` already existed and is overridden on SAIL.
- `srt/layers/attention/attention_registry.py`: on SAIL the hybrid GDN, KDA and GLM5-next branches build the SAIL classes, and the KDA prefill default comes from `sail_pla_prefill_default` (-> `flashkda`). That default stays a *per-runner* value fed into `resolve_linear_attn_backends(prefill_default=...)` and not a process-wide `--linear-attn-prefill-backend`, so a target/draft pair cannot hand a FlashKDA prefill slot to a non-KDA runner. SAIL is asked before the FlashInfer branch on purpose: PPU is CUDA-compatible, so `is_cuda()` plus an SM10x capability can both hold there and would otherwise claim the runner.
- `srt/models/kimi_k3.py`: the fused-decode layout is derived from `layer.num_v_heads` through `sail_kda.supported_fused_decode_heads(...)` instead of the fixed 12, and `bind_fused_decode_weight` stacks the conv weights into `_k3_fused_decode_weight` once, on the first decode step.

### 4. ReplaySSM verify/commit

- `srt/speculative/spec_utils.py` and `srt/layers/attention/hybrid_linear_attn_backend.py`: the commit call is built as kwargs once and offered to `sail_kda.commit_after_verify` first; a `False` answer hands the batch to the community Triton path unchanged.
- `srt/hardware_backend/sail/kernels/kda.py`: `commit_after_verify` accepts only the direct state layout — FP32 `(128, 128)` temporal, BF16 raw K / raw V, 1..32 steps, all five buffers contiguous, no request ring and no source-index remap — and passes the width-major conv pool as views instead of repacking it.
- `python/sglang/kernels/ops/mamba/mamba_state_scatter_sail.py` (new): the SAIL variants of the two masked scatter kernels, with sequential early-return bounds checks and an explicit `other=0.0` on the masked load. `mamba_state_scatter_triton.py` keeps the upstream kernels untouched; the two public wrappers dispatch on `is_sail_runtime()`.

### 5. Prefill: request per-chunk states only when they are read

`needs_intermediate_states` is true only when `track_ssm_h_src` has rows, i.e. only for chunk-unaligned tracked sequences. Chunk-aligned tracked rows copy the final state out of `ssm_states` and snapshot rows read `h_track_buf`, so neither reads `h`. Requesting it unconditionally pushed every tracked prefill onto a kernel that emits `h`, which kept the fused extend kernel out of the dense path. The extend result is now unpacked by type: `(out, h)` when a kernel emits states, a bare tensor when it does not.

### 6. Three fixes that are not SAIL-specific

- `fix(linear-attn): return the FlashKDA extend output without a tuple` — `FlashKDAKernel.extend` returned `(out, None)` even when `return_intermediate_states=False`, handing a tuple to every non-track prefill batch and breaking the `o_norm` / `fused_norm_gate` shape handling downstream. The NVIDIA and PTX prefill kernels return the output tensor alone; this now matches them.
- `fix(kimi-k3): keep the logical idle mode through DP speculative sync` — hybrid speculative DP rewrites an IDLE batch to TARGET_VERIFY so the linear ReplaySSM path can join the collective, but the batch has no full-attention metadata. Two places only looked at the physical mode: the K3 decoder layer ran the attention stack for a rank without metadata, and the hybrid backend's non-linear contributions came back uninitialized for the DP padding rows. Both now check the saved `_original_forward_mode`, and those rows are zero-filled instead of empty-filled. Without this, the uninitialized rows flow through `o_proj`/residual and poison the rank-synchronous MLP result.
- `fix(arg_groups): resolve the mamba cache strategy against the forced page size` — `_mamba_radix_cache_resolution` runs before `_mla_backend_page_constraints`, so `wants_paging` reads the request's raw page size and never sees the 64 that a FlashMLA backend forces. A hybrid-mamba model with FlashMLA and no explicit `--page-size` resolved to `no_buffer` while the KV pool still ended up at 64 tokens per page; `wants_paging` now treats a flashmla attention or decode backend as a paging need. The mismatch was invisible by default because `wants_overlap` short-circuits the same `or` unless `--disable-overlap-schedule` is set, and `validate_mamba_no_buffer` cannot catch it either, since it runs in an earlier slot too.

## Impact on non-SAIL platforms

Everything here sits behind `is_sail()` and a lazy import. What does reach a non-SAIL run:

- `FlashKDAKernel.extend` returns a bare tensor on the fused path (fix 1 above).
- Per-chunk states are requested only when chunk-unaligned tracked rows exist (section 5). Behavior-neutral by construction: those rows are the only readers.
- DP speculative decoding with a hybrid linear-attention model zero-fills rewritten-idle rows and skips full-attention metadata init for them (fix 2).
- `--mamba-radix-cache-strategy auto` counts a flashmla backend as a paging need (fix 3). This can change the resolved strategy for a non-SAIL Kimi-K3 + flashmla configuration under `--disable-overlap-schedule`, so it wants a CUDA check.
- The mamba state-scatter kernels compile from the same source as upstream: the SAIL variants are a separate file and the two shared wrappers gain one `is_sail_runtime()` early return.
- `attention_registry` keeps the previous FlashInfer Blackwell default for KDA prefill off SAIL.

These need a CUDA (Hopper/Blackwell) regression run before merge; the machine this branch was assembled on has neither a CUDA device nor a PPU.

## Known limitations

- The `pla` import is lazy, but a SAIL install without the wheel falls back with a warning rather than failing; the gate is forced off in that case even if it was set explicitly. `srt_sail` now pulls the wheel in.
- PLA fused decode covers head counts `{12, 24, 48, 96}` per rank; other TP layouts stay on the unfused chain.
- The PLA ReplaySSM commit only takes the direct state layout described in section 4; ring-buffer and remapped layouts keep the Triton scatter.
- The PLA packed decode hard-codes the community softplus constants (`beta=1.0`, `threshold=20.0`); if the Triton kernel's numerics change, this has to be revisited.
- `SGLANG_SAIL_PLA=0` returns both decode and prefill to Triton; there is no per-path opt-out, and an explicit `--linear-attn-prefill-backend` still overrides the prefill side alone.

## Accuracy Tests

The branch was assembled on a machine with no PPU and no CUDA device, so only static checks ran (`py_compile`, `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `pre-commit`). The runs that gate this PR:

- [ ] SAIL/PPU: Kimi-K3, TP8, PLA decode + ReplaySSM verify/commit under `--speculative-algorithm`, GSM8K and accepted length
- [ ] SAIL/PPU: Kimi-K3 prefill, `SGLANG_SAIL_PLA=1` vs `=0` (PLA `flashkda_fwd` vs Triton), GSM8K
- [ ] SAIL/PPU: a GDN model packed decode, GSM8K, no regression vs Triton
- [ ] CUDA (H100/H200): Kimi-K3 decode + prefill, GSM8K (regression for the extend contract, the tracked-`h` change and the radix-cache-strategy fix)
- [ ] CUDA (H100/H200): a GDN model with DP attention speculation (regression for the rewritten-idle fix)

Unit tests carried by the branch: `test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_pla_kda_dispatch.py` is new and CPU-only (`base-a-test-cpu`) — which kernel slot serves which mode, what the operators are handed, the graph-padding rows, the K3 head handoff, and every fallback path. Updated: `test/registered/unit/test_model_overrides.py`, `test/registered/attention/test_kda_prefill_flashkda.py`, `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_flashkda_strided_state_access.py`.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run yet.

- [ ] SAIL/PPU: Kimi-K3 decode, PLA vs Triton (`SGLANG_SAIL_PLA=1` vs `=0`), TP8
- [ ] SAIL/PPU: Kimi-K3 prefill, PLA `flashkda_fwd` vs the Triton chunk kernel
- [ ] SAIL/PPU: GDN packed decode, PLA vs Triton
- [ ] CUDA: no regression on Kimi-K3 prefill after the `needs_intermediate_states` change

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+import random
+from typing import List
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+def torch_validate_result(
+    # validate object
+    output_tensor,
+    output_tensor_scale,
+    output_index,
+    expert_start_loc,
+    # source
+    recv_x,
+    recv_x_scale,
+    recv_topk,
+    num_experts,
+):
+    output_tensor, output_index, expert_start_loc, recv_x, recv_topk = map(
+        lambda x: x.cpu(),
+        [output_tensor, output_index, expert_start_loc, recv_x, recv_topk],
+    )
+
+    assert (recv_topk >= 0).all()
+    expert_token_num = torch.bincount(recv_topk.view(-1), minlength=num_experts)
+    cumsum = torch.cumsum(expert_token_num, dim=0)
+    expert_start_loc_golden = torch.cat([torch.tensor([0]), cumsum[:-1]])
+
+    assert (expert_start_loc == expert_start_loc_golden).all()
+    expert_start_loc = expert_start_loc_golden
+    expert_end_loc = expert_start_loc + expert_token_num
+
+    recv_topk_flatten = recv_topk.view(-1)
+    output_index_flatten = output_index.view(-1)
+
+    check_bins = torch.bincount(
+        output_index_flatten, minlength=len(output_index_flatten)
+    )
+    assert len(check_bins) == len(output_index_flatten)
+    assert (check_bins == 1).all()
+
+    check_status = (expert_start_loc[recv_topk_flatten] <= output_index_flatten) & (
+        output_index_flatten < expert_end_loc[recv_topk_flatten]
+    )
+    if check_status.all():
+        print("output_index check pass")
+    else:
+        print("output_index check fail")
+        return
+
+    num_tokens = recv_x.shape[0]
+    for i in range(num_tokens):
+        check_status = output_tensor[output_index[i]] == recv_x[i].unsqueeze(0)
+        if not check_status.all():
+            print(f"output_tensor[{i}] check fail!")
+            break
+    else:
+        print("output_tensor check pass")
+
+    if output_tensor_scale is not None:
+        for i in range(num_tokens):
+            check_status = output_tensor_scale[output_index[i]] == recv_x_scale[
+                i
+            ].unsqueeze(0)
+            if not check_status.all():
+                print(f"output_tensor_scale[{i}] check fail!")
+                break
+        else:
+            print("output_tensor_scale check pass")
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _fwd_kernel_ep_scatter_2_optimal(
+    total_token_num,
+    expert_start_loc,
+    recv_x,
+    recv_x_stride0,
+    recv_x_stride1,
+    recv_x_scale,
+    recv_x_scale_stride0,
+    recv_x_scale_stride1,
+    recv_topk,
+    recv_topk_stride0,
+    recv_topk_stride1,
+    output_tensor,
+    output_tensor_stride0,
+    output_tensor_stride1,
+    output_tensor_scale,
+    output_tensor_scale_stride0,
+    output_tensor_scale_stride1,
+    output_index,
+    output_index_stride0,
+    output_index_stride1,
+    with_scale: tl.constexpr,
+    topk_num: tl.constexpr,
+    HIDDEN_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    SCALE_HIDDEN_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    COPY_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    num_stages: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token_id = tl.program_id(0)
+
+    expert_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    expert_mask = expert_offsets < topk_num
+    expert_loc = tl.load(
+        recv_topk + token_id * recv_topk_stride0 + expert_offsets, mask=expert_mask
+    )
+
+    tt_mask = expert_mask & (expert_loc >= 0)
+    dest_token_index_int32 = tl.atomic_add(
+        expert_start_loc + expert_loc, 1, mask=tt_mask
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        output_index + token_id * output_index_stride0 + expert_offsets,
+        dest_token_index_int32,
+        mask=tt_mask,
+        eviction_policy="evict_last",
+    )
+    tl.debug_barrier()
+    dest_token_index = tl.load(
+        output_index + token_id * output_index_stride0 + expert_offsets, mask=tt_mask
+    ).to(tl.int64)
+
+    value_offsets = tl.arange(0, COPY_SIZE)
+    for _ in tl.range(0, triton.cdiv(HIDDEN_SIZE, COPY_SIZE), num_stages=num_stages):
+        copy_mask = value_offsets < HIDDEN_SIZE
+        to_copy = tl.load(
+            recv_x + token_id * recv_x_stride0 + value_offsets, mask=copy_mask
+        )
+        output_offsets = (
+            dest_token_index[:, None] * output_tensor_stride0 + value_offsets[None, :]
+        )
+        to_copy = to_copy[None, :].broadcast_to(BLOCK_SIZE, COPY_SIZE)
+        tl.store(
+            output_tensor + output_offsets,
+            to_copy,
+            mask=(copy_mask[None, :] & tt_mask[:, None]),
+        )
+        value_offsets += COPY_SIZE
+
+    if with_scale:
+        scale_offsets = tl.arange(0, COPY_SIZE)
+        for _ in tl.range(
+            0,
+            triton.cdiv(SCALE_HIDDEN_SIZE, COPY_SIZE),
+        ):
+            copy_mask = scale_offsets < SCALE_HIDDEN_SIZE
+            to_copy_scale = tl.load(
+                recv_x_scale + token_id * recv_x_scale_stride0 + scale_offsets,
+                mask=copy_mask,
+            )
+            output_scale_offsets = (
+                dest_token_index[:, None] * output_tensor_scale_stride0
+                + scale_offsets[None, :]
+            )
+            to_copy_scale = to_copy_scale[None, :].broadcast_to(BLOCK_SIZE, COPY_SIZE)
+            tl.store(
+                output_tensor_scale + output_scale_offsets,
+                to_copy_scale,
+                mask=(copy_mask[None, :] & tt_mask[:, None]),
+            )
+            scale_offsets += COPY_SIZE
+
+
+def recover_topk_ids(
+    expert_num_tokens: List[int],
+    num_tokens,
+    num_experts,
+    num_experts_per_tok,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    assert len(expert_num_tokens) == num_experts
+    assert max(expert_num_tokens) <= num_tokens
+    assert sum(expert_num_tokens) == (num_tokens * num_experts_per_tok)
+
+    indices = list(range(len(expert_num_tokens)))
+    random.shuffle(indices)
+    tensor_slices = [
+        torch.ones(size=(expert_num_tokens[i],), dtype=torch.int32) * i for i in indices
+    ]
+    topk_ids = torch.cat(tensor_slices)
+    topk_ids = topk_ids.view(num_experts_per_tok, num_tokens).t().contiguous()
+
+    rand_idx = torch.argsort(torch.rand(num_tokens, num_experts_per_tok), dim=1)
+    topk_ids = torch.gather(topk_ids, 1, rand_idx)
+
+    indices = torch.randperm(topk_ids.size(0))
+    topk_ids = topk_ids[indices]
+    return topk_ids.contiguous()
+
+
+def base_test(
+    num_tokens: int,
+    hidden_size: int,
+    num_experts: int,
+    topk: int,
+    expert_num_tokens: List,
+    dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+):
+    hidden_size_scale = hidden_size // 128  # block_shape = [128, 128]
+    recv_x = torch.randn((num_tokens, hidden_size), dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
+    scales = torch.randn(
+        (num_tokens, hidden_size_scale), dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda"
+    )
+    topk_ids = recover_topk_ids(expert_num_tokens, num_tokens, num_experts, topk)
+
+    num_tokens_per_expert = torch.bincount(topk_ids.view(-1), minlength=num_experts)
+    cumsum = torch.cumsum(num_tokens_per_expert, dim=-1)
+    expert_start_loc = torch.cat([torch.tensor([0]), cumsum[:-1]])
+    topk_ids = topk_ids.view(num_tokens, topk).cuda()
+    expert_start_loc = expert_start_loc.cuda()
+
+    output_tensor = torch.zeros(
+        (num_tokens * topk, hidden_size), dtype=dtype, device="cuda"
+    )
+    output_index = torch.empty_like(topk_ids)
+    output_tensor_scale = torch.zeros(
+        (num_tokens * topk, hidden_size_scale), dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda"
+    )
+
+    expert_start_loc_origin = expert_start_loc.clone()
+    grid = lambda meta: (recv_x.shape[0],)
+    _fwd_kernel_ep_scatter_2_optimal[grid](
+        num_tokens,
+        expert_start_loc,
+        recv_x,
+        recv_x.stride(0),
+        recv_x.stride(1),
+        scales,
+        scales.stride(0),
+        scales.stride(1),
+        topk_ids,
+        topk_ids.stride(0),
+        topk_ids.stride(1),
+        output_tensor,
+        output_tensor.stride(0),
+        output_tensor.stride(1),
+        output_tensor_scale,
+        output_tensor_scale.stride(0),
+        output_tensor_scale.stride(1),
+        output_index,
+        output_index.stride(0),
+        output_index.stride(1),
+        with_scale=(scales is not None),
+        topk_num=topk,
+        HIDDEN_SIZE=hidden_size,
+        SCALE_HIDDEN_SIZE=hidden_size_scale,
+        BLOCK_SIZE=triton.next_power_of_2(topk_ids.shape[1]),
+        COPY_SIZE=512,
+        num_stages=3,
+        num_warps=8,
+    )
+
+    torch_validate_result(
+        output_tensor,
+        output_tensor_scale,
+        output_index,
+        expert_start_loc_origin,
+        recv_x,
+        scales,
+        topk_ids,
+        num_experts,
+    )
+

+_SAIL_ONLY_MSG = (
+    "{name} requires SAIL (__ppu_sgmdf); use the generic fallback otherwise."
+)

+_TP_BLOCK_N_FAST = 512  # full-warp (32 threads), for H divisible by 512
+_TP_BLOCK_N_MID = 256  # half-warp (16 threads), for H divisible by 256
+_TP_BLOCK_N_SAFE = 128  # 1/4-warp (8 threads), for any even H
+_EP_BLOCK_N = 256
+_FP8_BLOCK_THREADS = 256
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_tp_module(apply_clamp: bool, block_n: int) -> Module:
+    if not is_sail_runtime():
+        raise RuntimeError(_SAIL_ONLY_MSG.format(name="silu_and_mul_post_quant_mxfp4"))
+    clamp_str = "true" if apply_clamp else "false"
+    return load_jit(
+        "silu_and_mul_post_quant_mxfp4",
+        str(block_n),
+        clamp_str,
+        cuda_files=["elementwise/silu_and_mul_post_quant_mxfp4.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[
+            ("run", f"SiluMulMxfp4TP<{block_n},{clamp_str}>::run"),
+        ],
+        extra_cuda_cflags=["-use_fast_math"],
+    )
+
+
+def silu_and_mul_post_quant_mxfp4(
+    gateup: torch.Tensor,
+    swiglu_limit: Optional[float] = None,
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    assert gateup.ndim == 2, "input must be 2D (N, 2H)"
+    assert gateup.dtype == torch.bfloat16, "input must be bfloat16"
+    gateup = gateup.contiguous()
+
+    N, two_H = gateup.shape
+    H = two_H // 2
+    assert two_H % 2 == 0, "input last dim must be even"
+    assert H > 0 and H % 2 == 0, f"H must be positive and even, got H={H}"
+
+    # Dynamic block_n: prefer largest aligned block for better warp utilization
+    if H % _TP_BLOCK_N_FAST == 0:
+        block_n = _TP_BLOCK_N_FAST
+    elif H % _TP_BLOCK_N_MID == 0:
+        block_n = _TP_BLOCK_N_MID
+    else:
+        block_n = _TP_BLOCK_N_SAFE
+
+    # H_padded: H rounded up to block_n; kernel writes scale for all groups in [0, H_padded)
+    H_padded = ((H + block_n - 1) // block_n) * block_n
+    S_alloc = H_padded // 64
+    S_valid = (H + 63) // 64
+
+    out_quant = torch.empty((N, H // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device=gateup.device)
+    out_scale = torch.empty((S_alloc, N), dtype=torch.uint16, device=gateup.device)
+
+    if N == 0:
+        return out_quant, out_scale[:S_valid, :].t()
+
+    apply_clamp = swiglu_limit is not None
+    limit_val = float(swiglu_limit) if apply_clamp else 0.0
+
+    module = _jit_tp_module(apply_clamp, block_n)
+    module.run(gateup, out_quant, out_scale, limit_val)
+
+    return out_quant, out_scale[:S_valid, :].t()
+

+"""SAIL (PPU/HGGC) variants of the mamba state-scatter Triton kernels.
+
+The HGGC Triton backend does not lower the combined ``&`` bounds check of
+``mamba_state_scatter_triton`` into real branches and lets masked-out
+``tl.load`` lanes touch out-of-range addresses, so on SAIL the checks are
+written as sequential early-returns and the masked loads carry an explicit
+``other``. Keeping that variant here leaves the CUDA kernels in
+``mamba_state_scatter_triton`` untouched.
+
+Original integration: ``fix(mamba kernels): make mamba state scatter Triton
+kernels safe on PPU/HGGC`` (thmyl), see also ``fix(ppu): restore GLM DSA
+startup path``.
+"""
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mamba.mamba_state_scatter_triton import (
+    _prepare_src_rows,
+    _require_entry_contiguous_dst,
+)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _fused_mamba_state_scatter_with_mask_kernel(
+    src_ptr,
+    dst_ptr,
+    # Raw index arrays (before index_select)
+    dst_indices_raw_ptr,  # [total_requests] - state_indices_tensor
+    step_indices_raw_ptr,  # [total_requests] - last_correct_step_indices or mamba_steps_to_track
+    src_indices_raw_ptr,  # [total_requests] - verify scratch row for each request
+    elem_per_entry: tl.constexpr,
+    src_layer_stride,
+    src_req_stride,
+    src_step_stride,
+    dst_layer_stride,
+    dst_req_stride,
+    src_req_size,
+    src_step_size,
+    dst_req_size,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Fused gather-scatter kernel with built-in masking.
+
+    This kernel fuses the index_select operations by:
+    1. Iterating over all requests (pid_req from 0 to total_requests-1)
+    2. Checking if step_indices_raw[pid_req] >= 0 (valid mask)
+    3. If valid, performing the scatter:
+       dst[l, dst_indices_raw[pid_req], :] = src[l, pid_req, step_indices_raw[pid_req], :]
+
+    Grid: (total_requests, num_layers, ceil(elem_per_entry / BLOCK_SIZE))
+    """
+    pid_req = tl.program_id(0)
+    pid_layer = tl.program_id(1).to(tl.int64)
+    pid_block = tl.program_id(2).to(tl.int64)
+
+    # Load step index to check validity (step >= 0 means valid)
+    step_idx = tl.load(step_indices_raw_ptr + pid_req).to(tl.int64)
+
+    # Early exit if this request is not valid (step < 0)
+    if step_idx < 0:
+        return
+
+    # Load destination index
+    dst_idx = tl.load(dst_indices_raw_ptr + pid_req).to(tl.int64)
+
+    src_idx = tl.load(src_indices_raw_ptr + pid_req).to(tl.int64)
+
+    # Bounds check to avoid illegal memory access. Sequential early-returns are
+    # required here: HGGC does not lower the combined & form into branches.
+    if dst_idx < 0 or dst_idx >= dst_req_size:
+        return
+    if src_idx < 0 or src_idx >= src_req_size:
+        return
+    if step_idx < 0 or step_idx >= src_step_size:
+        return
+
+    # Compute base offsets
+    src_offset = (
+        pid_layer * src_layer_stride
+        + src_idx * src_req_stride
+        + step_idx * src_step_stride
+    )
+    dst_offset = pid_layer * dst_layer_stride + dst_idx * dst_req_stride
+
+    # Compute element range for this block
+    start = pid_block * BLOCK_SIZE
+    offsets = start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    mask = offsets < elem_per_entry
+
+    # Load from source and store to destination. other=0.0 keeps masked-out
+    # lanes off an out-of-range address on HGGC.
+    data = tl.load(src_ptr + src_offset + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    tl.store(dst_ptr + dst_offset + offsets, data, mask=mask)
+
+
+def fused_mamba_state_scatter_with_mask(
+    dst: torch.Tensor,  # [num_layers, cache_size, *state_shape]
+    src: torch.Tensor,  # [num_layers, spec_size, draft_tokens, *state_shape]
+    dst_indices_raw: torch.Tensor,  # [total_requests] - raw indices (e.g., state_indices_tensor)
+    step_indices_raw: torch.Tensor,  # [total_requests] - raw step indices (step >= 0 means valid)
+    src_indices_raw: torch.Tensor | None = None,  # [total_requests] - scratch rows
+):
+    """SAIL variant of :func:`fused_mamba_state_scatter_with_mask`.
+
+    Same contract and validation as the CUDA implementation; only the kernel's
+    bounds-check lowering differs.
+    """
+    total_requests = step_indices_raw.shape[0]
+    if total_requests == 0:
+        return
+
+    if dst.device != src.device:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"dst and src must be on the same device. {dst.device=} {src.device=}"
+        )
+    if not (dst.is_cuda or dst.is_xpu) or dst.device != src.device:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "fused_mamba_state_scatter_with_mask only supports CUDA/XPU tensors."
+        )
+    if dst.ndim < 2 or src.ndim < 3:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected tensor ranks: {dst.ndim=} {src.ndim=}")
+    if dst.shape[0] != src.shape[0]:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Layer dimension mismatch: {dst.shape[0]=} vs {src.shape[0]=}"
+        )
+    if dst.shape[2:] != src.shape[3:]:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Trailing dims mismatch: {dst.shape[2:]=} vs {src.shape[3:]=}"
+        )
+    if dst_indices_raw.ndim != 1 or step_indices_raw.ndim != 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"indices must be 1D: {dst_indices_raw.shape=} {step_indices_raw.shape=}"
+        )
+    if dst_indices_raw.shape[0] != step_indices_raw.shape[0]:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"indices length mismatch: {dst_indices_raw.shape[0]=} vs {step_indices_raw.shape[0]=}"
+        )
+
+    num_layers = dst.shape[0]
+    src_req_size = src.shape[1]
+    src_step_size = src.shape[2]
+    dst_req_size = dst.shape[1]
+
+    # Flatten trailing dimensions: number of elements per (layer, cache_line) entry.
+    elem_per_entry = dst.numel() // (dst.shape[0] * dst.shape[1])
+
+    # Get strides (in elements, not bytes)
+    src_layer_stride = src.stride(0)
+    src_req_stride = src.stride(1)
+    src_step_stride = src.stride(2)
+    dst_layer_stride = dst.stride(0)
+    dst_req_stride = dst.stride(1)
+
+    # Ensure indices are int32 and contiguous
+    dst_indices_raw = dst_indices_raw.to(torch.int32).contiguous()
+    step_indices_raw = step_indices_raw.to(torch.int32).contiguous()
+    src_indices_raw = _prepare_src_rows(src_indices_raw, step_indices_raw)
+
+    _require_entry_contiguous_dst(dst, 2, "fused_mamba_state_scatter_with_mask")
+    if not src.is_contiguous():
+        raise ValueError("src tensor must be contiguous")
+
+    # Block size for copying elements
+    BLOCK_SIZE = 1024
+
+    # Grid over all requests - invalid ones will early-exit in the kernel
+    grid = (total_requests, num_layers, triton.cdiv(elem_per_entry, BLOCK_SIZE))
+
+    _fused_mamba_state_scatter_with_mask_kernel[grid](
+        src,
+        dst,
+        dst_indices_raw,
+        step_indices_raw,
+        src_indices_raw,
+        elem_per_entry,
+        src_layer_stride,
+        src_req_stride,
+        src_step_stride,
+        dst_layer_stride,
+        dst_req_stride,
+        src_req_size,
+        src_step_size,
+        dst_req_size,
+        BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _fused_conv_window_scatter_with_mask_kernel(
+    src_ptr,
+    dst_ptr,
+    dst_indices_raw_ptr,  # [total_requests]
+    step_indices_raw_ptr,  # [total_requests], entry >= 0 means valid
+    src_indices_raw_ptr,  # [total_requests]
+    elem_per_entry: tl.constexpr,  # dim * (K-1)
+    KM1: tl.constexpr,  # K-1 (conv window width)
+    src_layer_stride,
+    src_req_stride,
+    src_step_stride,
+    src_dim_stride,
+    src_win_stride,
+    dst_layer_stride,
+    dst_req_stride,
+    src_req_size,
+    src_step_size,
+    dst_req_size,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Scatter accepted conv windows from the deduplicated sliding-window source.
+
+    Unlike ``_fused_mamba_state_scatter_with_mask_kernel`` (which flat-copies a
+    contiguous per-step state row), the source here is an *overlapping* view: the
+    deduplicated layout keeps one shared ``[dim, D+K-2]`` buffer per (layer, slot)
+    and step ``t``'s window is the slice ``shared[:, t:t+K-1]``. That window is
+    non-contiguous, so we index every ``(dim, win)`` element through the view's
+    strides (``src_step_stride`` / ``src_dim_stride`` / ``src_win_stride``). The
+    destination conv-state row stays contiguous in ``(dim, K-1)`` order.
+    """
+    pid_req = tl.program_id(0)
+    pid_layer = tl.program_id(1).to(tl.int64)
+    pid_block = tl.program_id(2).to(tl.int64)
+
+    step_idx = tl.load(step_indices_raw_ptr + pid_req).to(tl.int64)
+    if step_idx < 0:
+        return
+
+    dst_idx = tl.load(dst_indices_raw_ptr + pid_req).to(tl.int64)
+    src_idx = tl.load(src_indices_raw_ptr + pid_req).to(tl.int64)
+
+    # Sequential early-returns are required here: HGGC does not lower the
+    # combined & form into branches.
+    if dst_idx < 0 or dst_idx >= dst_req_size:
+        return
+    if src_idx < 0 or src_idx >= src_req_size:
+        return
+    if step_idx >= src_step_size:
+        return
+
+    start = pid_block * BLOCK_SIZE
+    e = start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    mask = e < elem_per_entry
+
+    # Decode the flat (dim, K-1)-row element index into (dim, win) coordinates.
+    d = e // KM1
+    w = e % KM1
+
+    src_off = (
+        pid_layer * src_layer_stride
+        + src_idx * src_req_stride
+        + step_idx * src_step_stride
+        + d * src_dim_stride
+        + w * src_win_stride
+    )
+    # dst window is contiguous in (dim, K-1) order -> flat element index `e`.
+    dst_off = pid_layer * dst_layer_stride + dst_idx * dst_req_stride + e
+
+    data = tl.load(src_ptr + src_off, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    tl.store(dst_ptr + dst_off, data, mask=mask)
+
+
+def fused_conv_window_scatter_with_mask(
+    dst: torch.Tensor,  # conv_states [num_layers, cache_size, dim, K-1] (contiguous)
+    src: torch.Tensor,  # deduped conv-window view [num_layers, spec_size, draft_tokens, dim, K-1]
+    dst_indices_raw: torch.Tensor,  # [total_requests]
+    step_indices_raw: torch.Tensor,  # [total_requests], entry >= 0 means valid
+    src_indices_raw: torch.Tensor | None = None,  # [total_requests]
+):
+    """SAIL variant of :func:`fused_conv_window_scatter_with_mask`.
+
+    ``src`` is the deduplicated sliding-window conv-intermediate cache: an
+    overlapping ``as_strided`` view over a shared ``[..., dim, D+K-2]`` buffer,
+    so its per-step windows are intentionally non-contiguous. This kernel indexes
+    ``(dim, win)`` elements through the view's strides instead of flat-copying.
+    ``dst`` (the real conv-state pool) is the usual contiguous
+    ``[layers, cache, dim, K-1]``.
+    """
+    total_requests = step_indices_raw.shape[0]
+    if total_requests == 0 or dst.numel() == 0:
+        return
+
+    if not (dst.is_cuda or dst.is_xpu) or dst.device != src.device:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "fused_conv_window_scatter_with_mask requires dst and src to be "
+            f"CUDA/XPU tensors on the same device ({dst.device=}, {src.device=})."
+        )
+    if dst.ndim != 4 or src.ndim != 5:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected ranks: {dst.ndim=} (want 4) {src.ndim=} (want 5)")
+    if dst.shape[0] != src.shape[0]:
+        raise ValueError(f"Layer dim mismatch: {dst.shape[0]=} vs {src.shape[0]=}")
+    if dst.shape[2:] != src.shape[3:]:
+        raise ValueError(f"Window dims mismatch: {dst.shape[2:]=} vs {src.shape[3:]=}")
+    if dst_indices_raw.ndim != 1 or step_indices_raw.ndim != 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"indices must be 1D: {dst_indices_raw.shape=} {step_indices_raw.shape=}"
+        )
+    if dst_indices_raw.shape[0] != step_indices_raw.shape[0]:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"indices length mismatch: {dst_indices_raw.shape[0]=} vs {step_indices_raw.shape[0]=}"
+        )
+
+    num_layers = dst.shape[0]
+    dim = dst.shape[2]
+    km1 = dst.shape[3]
+    elem_per_entry = dim * km1
+
+    src_req_size = src.shape[1]
+    src_step_size = src.shape[2]
+    dst_req_size = dst.shape[1]
+
+    # `src` is an intentionally non-contiguous (overlapping) view indexed per
+    # dim through its real strides, so we do NOT assert src contiguity here
+    # (unlike the dense scatter).
+    _require_entry_contiguous_dst(dst, 2, "fused_conv_window_scatter_with_mask")
+
+    dst_indices_raw = dst_indices_raw.to(torch.int32).contiguous()
+    step_indices_raw = step_indices_raw.to(torch.int32).contiguous()
+    src_indices_raw = _prepare_src_rows(src_indices_raw, step_indices_raw)
+
+    BLOCK_SIZE = 1024
+    grid = (total_requests, num_layers, triton.cdiv(elem_per_entry, BLOCK_SIZE))
+
+    _fused_conv_window_scatter_with_mask_kernel[grid](
+        src,
+        dst,
+        dst_indices_raw,
+        step_indices_raw,
+        src_indices_raw,
+        elem_per_entry,
+        km1,
+        src.stride(0),
+        src.stride(1),
+        src.stride(2),
+        src.stride(3),
+        src.stride(4),
+        dst.stride(0),
+        dst.stride(1),
+        src_req_size,
+        src_step_size,
+        dst_req_size,
+        BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE,
+    )

+    """Retile group-32 E8M0 bytes into the [E, N/64, K*2] layout for W4A16 MMA."""
+    if scales.ndim != 3:
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected [E, N, K/32] scales, got {scales.shape}.")
+    if scales.dtype == torch.float8_e8m0fnu:
+        scales = scales.view(torch.uint8)
+    elif scales.dtype != torch.uint8:
+        raise TypeError(f"Expected uint8/E8M0 scales, got {scales.dtype}.")

+    k = k_groups * 32
+    if n % 64 != 0 or k % 64 != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"W4A16 MMA requires N/K multiples of 64, got N={n}, K={k}.")

+        [
+            2 * i + j * 16 + offset
+            for i in range(8)
+            for j in range(8)
+            for offset in (0, 1)
+        ],
+        dtype=torch.long,
+        device=scales.device,
+    )
+    scales = (
+        scales.reshape(num_experts, n // 64, 64, k // 64, 2)
+        .permute(0, 1, 3, 2, 4)
+        .reshape(-1, 128)
+    )
+    return (
+        scales.index_select(1, scale_perm)
+        .reshape(num_experts, n // 64, k * 2)
+        .contiguous()
+    )

+    mx_tensor_ptr,

+        "Scale must be uint16 (preprocessed E8M0).",
+    )

+        or (src_dtype == tl.float32),

+    quant_block = tl.program_id(1).to(tl.int64)

+                (N, S_groups_pairs), dtype=torch.uint16, device=src_tensor.device
+            )
+            kernel_scale_stride = (kernel_scale.stride(1), kernel_scale.stride(0))
+        else:
+            kernel_scale = torch.empty(
+                (S_groups_pairs, N), dtype=torch.uint16, device=src_tensor.device
+            )

+

+        BLOCK_QUANT = 128
+        NUM_WARPS = 4

+        grid = (
+            triton.cdiv(N, BLOCK_OUT),
+            triton.cdiv(padded_L, BLOCK_QUANT),
+        )

+        _downcast_to_mxfp4[grid](
+            kernel_quant,
+            *kernel_quant.stride(),
+            kernel_scale,
+            *kernel_scale_stride,
+            kernel_src,
+            *kernel_src.stride(),
+            N,
+            padded_L,
+            L,
+            BLOCK_SIZE_OUT_DIM=BLOCK_OUT,
+            BLOCK_SIZE_QUANT_DIM=BLOCK_QUANT,
+            DEQUANT_SCALE_ROUNDING_MODE=0 if round_up else 1,
+            num_warps=NUM_WARPS,

+            *batch_shape, S_groups_pairs

+                (*batch_shape, S_groups_pairs),

+                    device=src_tensor.device,
+                )

+    out_scale = out_scale.transpose(axis, ndim - 1)

+"""SAIL GDN attention backend: PLA behind the GDN kernel slots.
+
+The community ``GDNAttnBackend`` keeps its Triton / CuTe DSL / FlashInfer
+implementations; this module only rebinds the Triton slots to the PLA-backed
+kernel, which itself falls back to the community kernel for everything the
+operator does not cover.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.sail.attention.gdn_triton import SailTritonGDNKernel
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.linear.gdn_backend import (
+    GDNAttnBackend,
+    GDNKernelDispatcher,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.linear.kernels.gdn_triton import TritonGDNKernel
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.linear.utils import LinearAttnKernelBackend
+
+
+class SailGDNKernelDispatcher(GDNKernelDispatcher):
+    """GDN kernel dispatcher whose Triton slots run on PLA."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        decode_backend: LinearAttnKernelBackend,
+        prefill_backend: LinearAttnKernelBackend,
+        verify_backend: Optional[LinearAttnKernelBackend] = None,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(decode_backend, prefill_backend, verify_backend)
+        sail_triton = SailTritonGDNKernel()
+        for slot in (
+            "decode_kernel",
+            "extend_kernel",
+            "verify_kernel",
+            "tree_verify_kernel",
+        ):
+            if isinstance(getattr(self, slot), TritonGDNKernel):
+                setattr(self, slot, sail_triton)
+
+
+class SailGDNAttnBackend(GDNAttnBackend):
+    """GDNAttnBackend whose Triton kernel slots run on the PLA operators."""
+
+    def _create_kernel_dispatcher(self, backends):
+        return SailGDNKernelDispatcher(
+            backends.decode, backends.prefill, backends.verify
+        )

+"""SAIL GDN Triton-backend slots served by the PLA operators.
+
+GDN and KDA share the PLA recurrent operators (no safe gate, no fused conv
+step), so the wrappers in ``sail.kernels.kda`` serve both. What PLA does not
+accept -- the ReplaySSM ring write, a non-fp32 state pool -- keeps the
+community Triton kernel.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.sail.kernels import kda as sail_kda
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.linear.kernels.gdn_triton import TritonGDNKernel
+
+
+class SailTritonGDNKernel(TritonGDNKernel):
+    """Triton GDN kernel slots served by PLA."""
+
+    def packed_decode(
+        self,
+        mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,
+        a: torch.Tensor,
+        b: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        A_log: torch.Tensor,
+        dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+        scale: float,
+        ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+        cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        num_v_heads: int,
+        head_v_dim: int,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # The ReplaySSM buffered decode writes per-layer rings; that layout is
+        # Triton-only.
+        if not sail_kda.pla_enabled() or kwargs.get("replayssm_d") is not None:
+            return super().packed_decode(
+                mixed_qkv,
+                a,
+                b,
+                A_log=A_log,
+                dt_bias=dt_bias,
+                scale=scale,
+                ssm_states=ssm_states,
+                cache_indices=cache_indices,
+                num_v_heads=num_v_heads,
+                head_v_dim=head_v_dim,
+                **kwargs,
+            )
+        B = mixed_qkv.shape[0]
+        out = mixed_qkv.new_empty(B, 1, num_v_heads, head_v_dim)
+        out, _ = sail_kda.packed_decode(
+            mixed_qkv=mixed_qkv,
+            a=a,
+            b=b,
+            A_log=A_log.reshape(-1),
+            dt_bias=dt_bias.reshape(-1),
+            scale=scale,
+            initial_state=ssm_states,
+            out=out,
+            ssm_state_indices=cache_indices,
+        )
+        return out.transpose(0, 1)
+
+    def decode(
+        self,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        k: torch.Tensor,
+        v: torch.Tensor,
+        a: torch.Tensor,
+        b: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        A_log: torch.Tensor,
+        dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+        ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+        cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not sail_kda.recurrent_update_supported(False, ssm_states, None):
+            return super().decode(
+                q,
+                k,
+                v,
+                a,
+                b,
+                A_log=A_log,
+                dt_bias=dt_bias,
+                ssm_states=ssm_states,
+                cache_indices=cache_indices,
+                query_start_loc=query_start_loc,
+                **kwargs,
+            )
+        return sail_kda.recurrent_update(
+            A_log=A_log,
+            a=a,
+            dt_bias=dt_bias,
+            softplus_beta=sail_kda.PLA_SOFT_BETA,
+            softplus_threshold=sail_kda.PLA_SOFT_THRESHOLD,
+            q=q,
+            k=k,
+            v=v,
+            b=b,
+            initial_state_source=ssm_states,
+            initial_state_indices=cache_indices,
+            cu_seqlens=query_start_loc,
+            use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=True,
+            is_kda=False,
+        )
+
+    def target_verify(
+        self,
+        A_log: torch.Tensor,
+        dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        k: torch.Tensor,
+        v: torch.Tensor,
+        a: torch.Tensor,
+        b: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+        cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_states_buffer: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_state_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        cache_steps: int,
+        retrieve_parent_token: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not sail_kda.recurrent_update_supported(
+            bool(kwargs.get("cache_ring", False)),
+            ssm_states,
+            intermediate_states_buffer,
+        ):
+            return super().target_verify(
+                A_log,
+                dt_bias,
+                q,
+                k,
+                v,
+                a,
+                b,
+                ssm_states=ssm_states,
+                cache_indices=cache_indices,
+                query_start_loc=query_start_loc,
+                intermediate_states_buffer=intermediate_states_buffer,
+                intermediate_state_indices=intermediate_state_indices,
+                cache_steps=cache_steps,
+                retrieve_parent_token=retrieve_parent_token,
+                **kwargs,
+            )
+        return sail_kda.recurrent_update(
+            A_log=A_log,
+            a=a,
+            dt_bias=dt_bias,
+            softplus_beta=sail_kda.PLA_SOFT_BETA,
+            softplus_threshold=sail_kda.PLA_SOFT_THRESHOLD,
+            q=q,
+            k=k,
+            v=v,
+            b=b,
+            initial_state_source=ssm_states,
+            initial_state_indices=cache_indices,
+            cu_seqlens=query_start_loc,
+            use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=True,
+            is_kda=False,
+            disable_state_update=True,
+            intermediate_states_buffer=intermediate_states_buffer,
+            intermediate_state_indices=intermediate_state_indices,
+            cache_steps=cache_steps,
+            retrieve_parent_token=retrieve_parent_token,
+        )

+"""SAIL KDA attention backend: the PLA operators behind the KDA interfaces.
+
+The community ``KDAAttnBackend`` keeps its Triton / CuTe DSL / FlashInfer
+implementations; this module only overrides the pieces that are served by the
+PLA operator library on PPU. ``SGLANG_SAIL_PLA`` gates every override, so a
+PLA-less install falls back to the inherited implementations.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.sail.attention.kda_flashkda import (
+    SailFlashKDAKernel,
+)
+from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.sail.attention.kda_triton import SailTritonKDAKernel
+from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.sail.kernels import kda as sail_kda
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.linear.kda_backend import (
+    KDAAttnBackend,
+    KDAKernelDispatcher,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.linear.kernels.kernel_backend import (
+    LinearAttnKernelBackend,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.radix_linear_attention import RadixLinearAttention
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_sail
+
+
+def sail_pla_prefill_default(model_config) -> Optional[str]:
+    """This runner's SAIL KDA prefill default: the PLA kernel.
+
+    Returned as a *per-runner default* (fed into
+    ``resolve_linear_attn_backends(prefill_default=...)``) rather than written
+    into the process-wide ``--linear-attn-prefill-backend`` value, because a
+    target and its speculative draft coexist in one process and can want
+    different prefill kernels. KDA target models opt in here; a draft runner
+    whose model is GDN keeps its own backend (GDNKernelDispatcher has no
+    FlashKDA prefill kernel and rejects it). An explicit
+    ``--linear-attn-prefill-backend`` still wins over this default.
+    """
+    if not is_sail() or not envs.SGLANG_SAIL_PLA.get():
+        return None
+    try:
+        hf_config = model_config.hf_config
+    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - resolution must not fail on this probe
+        return None
+    from sglang.srt.configs.model_config import uses_kda_attention
+
+    if not uses_kda_attention(hf_config):
+        return None
+    return "flashkda"
+
+
+class SailKDAKernelDispatcher(KDAKernelDispatcher):
+    """KDA kernel dispatcher that binds the PLA-backed kernel slots.
+
+    On SAIL only fused decode and the FlashKDA prefill/prefill-graph interface
+    exist; decode, verify and any other prefill backend stay on Triton because
+    that is the only implementation PLA covers.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        decode_backend: LinearAttnKernelBackend,
+        prefill_backend: LinearAttnKernelBackend,
+        verify_backend: LinearAttnKernelBackend,
+    ):
+        if not prefill_backend.is_flashkda():
+            prefill_backend = LinearAttnKernelBackend.TRITON
+        super().__init__(
+            LinearAttnKernelBackend.TRITON,
+            prefill_backend,
+            LinearAttnKernelBackend.TRITON,
+        )
+        sail_triton = SailTritonKDAKernel()
+        self.decode_kernel = sail_triton
+        self.verify_kernel = sail_triton
+        if prefill_backend.is_flashkda():
+            self.extend_kernel = SailFlashKDAKernel()
+
+
+class SailKDAAttnBackend(KDAAttnBackend):
+    """KDAAttnBackend whose fused slots run on the PLA operators."""
+
+    def _create_kernel_dispatcher(self, backends) -> KDAKernelDispatcher:
+        return SailKDAKernelDispatcher(
+            backends.decode, backends.prefill, backends.verify
+        )
+
+    def _fused_decode_covered(
+        self,
+        mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,
+        a: torch.Tensor,
+        b: torch.Tensor,
+        conv_states: torch.Tensor,
+        ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+        cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        onorm_gate: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> bool:
+        if not sail_kda.pla_enabled():
+            return super()._fused_decode_covered(
+                mixed_qkv, a, b, conv_states, ssm_states, cache_indices, onorm_gate
+            )
+        return sail_kda.fused_decode_covered(
+            mixed_qkv, a, b, conv_states, ssm_states, cache_indices, onorm_gate
+        )
+
+    def _run_fused_decode(
+        self,
+        *,
+        mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,
+        a: torch.Tensor,
+        b: torch.Tensor,
+        conv_states: torch.Tensor,
+        fused_static: tuple,
+        layer: RadixLinearAttention,
+        forward_batch,
+        onorm_gate: torch.Tensor,
+        ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+        cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not sail_kda.pla_enabled():
+            return super()._run_fused_decode(
+                mixed_qkv=mixed_qkv,
+                a=a,
+                b=b,
+                conv_states=conv_states,
+                fused_static=fused_static,
+                layer=layer,
+                forward_batch=forward_batch,
+                onorm_gate=onorm_gate,
+                ssm_states=ssm_states,
+                cache_indices=cache_indices,
+            )
+        _, _, _, conv_bias, a_log, onorm_w, onorm_eps = fused_static
+        return sail_kda.fused_decode(
+            mixed_qkv=mixed_qkv,
+            a=a,
+            b=b,
+            conv_states=conv_states,
+            conv_bias=conv_bias,
+            A_log=a_log,
+            dt_bias=layer.dt_bias,
+            onorm_g=onorm_gate,
+            onorm_weight=onorm_w,
+            ssm_states=ssm_states,
+            cache_indices=cache_indices,
+            onorm_eps=onorm_eps,
+            fused_weight=getattr(layer, "_k3_fused_decode_weight", None),
+            actual_batch_size=getattr(forward_batch, "_original_batch_size", None),
+            lower_bound=layer.lower_bound,
+        )
+
+    def _can_run_dspark_cutedsl_mtp(
+        self,
+        *,
+        layer: RadixLinearAttention,
+        mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,
+        a: torch.Tensor,
+        b: torch.Tensor,
+        draft_token_num: int,
+        ragged_layout,
+        conv_states: torch.Tensor,
+        ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_state_cache: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+        intermediate_conv_window_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        retrieve_parent_token: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+        replayssm_rawv: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Whether the PLA verify inputs are supported for this batch."""
+        if not sail_kda.pla_enabled():
+            return super()._can_run_dspark_cutedsl_mtp(
+                layer=layer,
+                mixed_qkv=mixed_qkv,
+                a=a,
+                b=b,
+                draft_token_num=draft_token_num,
+                ragged_layout=ragged_layout,
+                conv_states=conv_states,
+                ssm_states=ssm_states,
+                intermediate_state_cache=intermediate_state_cache,
+                intermediate_conv_window_cache=intermediate_conv_window_cache,
+                retrieve_parent_token=retrieve_parent_token,
+                replayssm_rawv=replayssm_rawv,
+            )
+        # PLA still indexes its ring by Mamba slot; a request-level ring keeps
+        # the Triton path.
+        pool = self.state_pool
+        if pool is not None and pool.replayssm_request_ring:
+            return False
+        if ragged_layout is not None or retrieve_parent_token is not None:
+            return False
+        # draft_token_num = 1 bonus + dspark block size; the operator is
+        # specialized per block size and capped at 8 by shared-memory growth.
+        if not 2 <= draft_token_num <= 8:
+            return False
+        if layer.bias is not None or layer.lower_bound is None:
+            return False
+        if (
+            layer.head_q_dim != 128
+            or layer.head_k_dim != 128
+            or layer.head_v_dim != 128
+        ):
+            return False
+        if (
+            layer.num_q_heads != layer.num_k_heads
+            or layer.num_k_heads != layer.num_v_heads
+        ):
+            return False
+        if (
+            mixed_qkv.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or a.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or b.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+        ):
+            return False
+        if layer.conv_weights is None or tuple(layer.conv_weights.shape) != (
+            layer.q_dim + layer.k_dim + layer.v_dim,
+            4,
+        ):
+            return False
+        if layer.conv_weights.dtype != torch.float32:
+            return False
+        if (
+            ssm_states.dtype != torch.float32
+            or tuple(ssm_states.shape[-3:])
+            != (layer.num_v_heads, layer.head_v_dim, layer.head_k_dim)
+            or tuple(ssm_states.stride()[-3:])
+            != (
+                layer.head_v_dim * layer.head_k_dim,
+                layer.head_k_dim,
+                1,
+            )
+            or ssm_states.stride(0) % 4 != 0
+            or ssm_states.storage_offset() % 4 != 0
+        ):
+            return False
+        if conv_states.shape[-2] != 3 or intermediate_conv_window_cache.shape[-2] != 3:
+            return False
+        # PLA verify writes raw-input rings, not per-token SSM snapshots.
+        # Unsupported serving layouts keep the Triton path.
+        if intermediate_state_cache is not None or replayssm_rawv is None:
+            return False
+        cache = self.state_layer_cache(layer.layer_id)
+        rings = (
+            replayssm_rawv,
+            cache.replayssm_rawk,
+            cache.replayssm_g,
+            cache.replayssm_beta,
+        )
+        dtypes = (torch.bfloat16, torch.bfloat16, torch.float32, torch.float32)
+        if any(t is None or t.dtype != dtype for t, dtype in zip(rings, dtypes)):
+            return False
+        if layer.A_log.dtype != torch.float32 or layer.dt_bias.dtype != torch.float32:
+            return False
+        if (
+            conv_states.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or intermediate_conv_window_cache.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+        ):
+            return False
+        seq_len, dim = mixed_qkv.shape[0], layer.num_v_heads * 128
+        if (
+            mixed_qkv.shape[1] != 3 * dim
+            or mixed_qkv.stride(-1) != 1
+            or a.shape
+            not in (
+                (seq_len, dim),
+                (1, seq_len, dim),
+                (1, seq_len, layer.num_v_heads, 128),
+            )
+            or b.shape
+            not in ((seq_len, layer.num_v_heads), (1, seq_len, layer.num_v_heads))
+            or a.stride(-1) != 1
+            or b.stride(-1) != 1
+            or (a.ndim == 4 and a.stride(-2) != 128)
+        ):
+            return False
+        # PLA reads/writes conv windows by stride; commit accepts either dense
+        # axis order for conv state.
+        if not intermediate_conv_window_cache.is_contiguous() and any(
+            s <= 0 for s in intermediate_conv_window_cache.stride()
+        ):
+            return False
+        return (
+            conv_states.is_contiguous() or conv_states.transpose(-1, -2).is_contiguous()
+        ) and all(t.is_contiguous() for t in (ssm_states, *rings))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _run_dspark_cutedsl_mtp(
+        *,
+        layer: RadixLinearAttention,
+        mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,
+        a: torch.Tensor,
+        b: torch.Tensor,
+        conv_states: torch.Tensor,
+        ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_state_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_conv_window_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_state_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.sail.kernels import kda as sail_kda
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.linear.kernels.kda_triton import TritonKDAKernel
+
+
+class SailTritonKDAKernel(TritonKDAKernel):
+    """Triton KDA kernel slots served by PLA.
+
+    ``SGLANG_SAIL_PLA`` selects between the two implementations; everything the
+    operator does not accept (a non-fp32 state pool, the ReplaySSM ring write)
+    keeps the community Triton kernel.
+    """

+    def packed_decode(
+        self,
+        mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,
+        a: torch.Tensor,
+        b: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        A_log: torch.Tensor,
+        dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+        scale: float,
+        ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+        cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        num_v_heads: int,
+        head_v_dim: int,
+        lower_bound: Optional[float] = None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not sail_kda.pla_enabled() or kwargs.get("replayssm_d") is not None:
+            return super().packed_decode(
+                mixed_qkv,
+                a,
+                b,
+                A_log=A_log,
+                dt_bias=dt_bias,
+                scale=scale,
+                ssm_states=ssm_states,
+                cache_indices=cache_indices,
+                num_v_heads=num_v_heads,
+                head_v_dim=head_v_dim,
+                lower_bound=lower_bound,
+                **kwargs,
+            )
+        B = mixed_qkv.shape[0]
+        out = mixed_qkv.new_empty(B, 1, num_v_heads, head_v_dim)
+        out, _ = sail_kda.packed_decode(
+            mixed_qkv=mixed_qkv,
+            a=a,
+            b=b,
+            A_log=A_log.reshape(-1),
+            dt_bias=dt_bias.reshape(-1),
+            scale=scale,
+            initial_state=ssm_states,
+            out=out,
+            ssm_state_indices=cache_indices,
+        )
+        # [B, 1, HV, V] -> [1, B, HV, V] view, the decode output layout.
+        return out.transpose(0, 1)
+
+    def decode(
+        self,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        k: torch.Tensor,
+        v: torch.Tensor,
+        a: torch.Tensor,
+        b: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        A_log: torch.Tensor,
+        dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+        ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+        cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+        query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,
+        lower_bound: Optional[float] = None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not sail_kda.recurrent_update_supported(False, ssm_states, None):
+            return super().decode(
+                q,
+                k,
+                v,
+                a,
+                b,
+                A_log=A_log,
+                dt_bias=dt_bias,
+                ssm_states=ssm_states,
+                cache_indices=cache_indices,
+                query_start_loc=query_start_loc,
+                lower_bound=lower_bound,
+                **kwargs,
+            )
+        return sail_kda.recurrent_update(
+            A_log=A_log,
+            a=a,
+            dt_bias=dt_bias,
+            softplus_beta=sail_kda.PLA_SOFT_BETA,
+            softplus_threshold=sail_kda.PLA_SOFT_THRESHOLD,
+            q=q,
+            k=k,
+            v=v,
+            b=b,
+            initial_state_source=ssm_states,
+            initial_state_indices=cache_indices,
+            cu_seqlens=query_start_loc,
+            use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=True,
+            is_kda=True,
+            lower_bound=lower_bound,
+        )
+
+    def target_verify(
+        self,
+        A_log: torch.Tensor,
+        dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        k: torch.Tensor,
+        v: torch.Tensor,

+        cache_steps: int,
+        retrieve_parent_token: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+        lower_bound: Optional[float] = None,
+        cache_ring: bool = False,
+        replayssm_rawv: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        replayssm_rawk: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        replayssm_g: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        replayssm_beta: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        ring_indices: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not sail_kda.recurrent_update_supported(
+            cache_ring, ssm_states, intermediate_states_buffer
+        ):
+            return super().target_verify(
+                A_log,

+                q,

+                v,

+"""PLA operator wrappers behind the SAIL KDA fast paths.
+
+``pla`` is the PPU linear-attention kernel library shipped as its own wheel.
+Every call site here is gated by ``SGLANG_SAIL_PLA`` (turned on by
+``arg_groups.platform_hook.handle_sail_backends`` when ``pla`` imports), so a
+PLA-less installation and every non-SAIL backend keep the community
+Triton/CUDA implementations in ``sglang.kernels``. Keeping the vendor calls in
+this module is what lets the upstream kernel files stay platform-free.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+
+# The packed-decode operator hard-codes the community softplus constants.
+PLA_SOFT_BETA = 1.0
+PLA_SOFT_THRESHOLD = 20.0
+
+# Per-rank head counts of the PLA KDA decode kernel.
+SUPPORTED_FUSED_DECODE_HEADS = {12, 24, 48, 96}
+
+
+def pla_enabled() -> bool:
+    """Whether the PLA operator library may be used for this process."""
+    return envs.SGLANG_SAIL_PLA.get()
+
+
+def _load_decode():
+    from pla.decode import (
+        fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_forward_k_last,
+        fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_forward_k_last_packed,
+    )
+
+    return (
+        fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_forward_k_last,
+        fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_forward_k_last_packed,
+    )
+
+
+def fused_decode_covered(
+    mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,
+    a: torch.Tensor,
+    b: torch.Tensor,
+    conv_states: torch.Tensor,
+    ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+    cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    onorm_g: torch.Tensor,
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether the PLA fused decode operator takes this decode batch."""
+    if not pla_enabled() or ssm_states.ndim < 4:
+        return False
+    return ssm_states.shape[-3] in SUPPORTED_FUSED_DECODE_HEADS
+
+
+def fused_decode(
+    mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,
+    a: torch.Tensor,
+    b: torch.Tensor,
+    conv_states: torch.Tensor,
+    conv_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    A_log: torch.Tensor,
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    onorm_g: torch.Tensor,
+    onorm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+    cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    onorm_eps: float,
+    fused_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    actual_batch_size: Optional[int],
+    lower_bound: Optional[float] = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Fused conv + recurrence + gated RMSNorm decode step on PLA.
+
+    Returns the packed-decode output layout ``[1, B, HV, V]``. Rows past
+    ``actual_batch_size`` are padding rows of a graph-shaped batch; their
+    output is zeroed and their state slots are left alone.
+    """
+    from pla.decode.kda import fused_kda_decode_mega_forward
+
+    B = mixed_qkv.shape[0]
+    H = ssm_states.shape[-3]
+    if actual_batch_size is None:
+        actual_batch_size = B
+    output_shape = (1, B, H, 128)
+    out = (
+        mixed_qkv.new_empty(output_shape)
+        if actual_batch_size == B
+        else mixed_qkv.new_zeros(output_shape)
+    )
+    fused_kda_decode_mega_forward(
+        x=mixed_qkv[:actual_batch_size],
+        weight=fused_weight,
+        bias=conv_bias,
+        conv_state=conv_states.transpose(-1, -2),
+        raw_g=a[:actual_batch_size].reshape(1, actual_batch_size, H, 128),
+        raw_beta=b[:actual_batch_size].unsqueeze(0),
+        a_log=A_log,
+        dt_bias=dt_bias,
+        state_indices=cache_indices[:actual_batch_size],
+        state=ssm_states,
+        out=out[:, :actual_batch_size],
+        lower_bound=lower_bound,
+        output_gate=onorm_g[:actual_batch_size].reshape(actual_batch_size, H, 128),
+        norm_weight=onorm_weight,
+        norm_eps=onorm_eps,
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+def recurrent_update_supported(
+    cache_ring: bool,
+    initial_state_source: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    intermediate_states_buffer: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether PLA takes this recurrent decode/verify batch.
+
+    The PLA operator has no ReplaySSM ring-write contract and only carries the
+    fp32 state pool the KDA checkpoints use; anything else stays on Triton.
+    """
+    if not pla_enabled() or cache_ring:
+        return False
+    return all(
+        t is None or t.dtype == torch.float32
+        for t in (initial_state_source, intermediate_states_buffer)
+    )
+
+
+def recurrent_update(
+    A_log: torch.Tensor,
+    a: torch.Tensor,
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    softplus_beta: float,
+    softplus_threshold: float,
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    b: torch.Tensor,
+    initial_state_source: torch.Tensor,
+    initial_state_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    scale: Optional[float] = None,
+    use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel: bool = False,
+    cu_seqlens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    is_kda: bool = False,
+    lower_bound: Optional[float] = None,
+    disable_state_update: bool = False,
+    intermediate_states_buffer: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    intermediate_state_indices: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    cache_steps: Optional[int] = None,
+    retrieve_parent_token: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Recurrent delta-rule decode / target-verify step on PLA."""
+    fused_forward_k_last, _ = _load_decode()
+
+    def _gate_cast(t: Optional[torch.Tensor]) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+        # The operator builds the softplus gate from A_log/dt_bias on the
+        # state-update path; it wants them in the activation dtype there and
+        # keeps the verify (state-read) path's own dtype.
+        if t is None:
+            return None
+        return t if disable_state_update else t.to(q.dtype)
+
+    kda_lower_bound = (
+        (lower_bound if lower_bound is not None else 0.0) if is_kda else None
+    )
+    return fused_forward_k_last(
+        _gate_cast(A_log),
+        a,
+        _gate_cast(dt_bias),
+        softplus_beta,
+        softplus_threshold,
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        b,
+        initial_state_source,
+        initial_state_indices,
+        scale,
+        use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel,
+        cu_seqlens,
+        is_kda,
+        disable_state_update,
+        intermediate_states_buffer,
+        intermediate_state_indices,
+        cache_steps,
+        retrieve_parent_token,
+        kda_lower_bound,
+    )
+
+
+def packed_decode(
+    mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,
+    a: torch.Tensor,
+    b: torch.Tensor,
+    A_log: torch.Tensor,
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    scale: float,
+    initial_state: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    ssm_state_indices: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Packed single-token decode on PLA; returns ``(out, final_state)``."""
+    _, fused_packed = _load_decode()
+
+    B = mixed_qkv.shape[0]
+    K = initial_state.shape[-1]
+    out = fused_packed(
+        mixed_qkv,
+        a,
+        b,
+        A_log,
+        dt_bias,
+        PLA_SOFT_BETA,
+        PLA_SOFT_THRESHOLD,
+        K**-0.5,
+        initial_state,
+        ssm_state_indices,
+        out,
+        True,
+        torch.arange(B + 1, device=a.device, dtype=torch.int32),
+        False,
+    )
+    return out, initial_state
+
+
+def prefill(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    g: torch.Tensor,
+    beta: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    A_log: torch.Tensor,
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    scale: float,
+    lower_bound: Optional[float],
+    initial_state: torch.Tensor,
+    final_state: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """FlashKDA-style chunked prefill on PLA (writes ``out``/``final_state``)."""
+    from pla.prefill.flashkdapro import flashkda_fwd
+
+    # q/k carry H heads; v, g and the output carry HV. They agree for the
+    # checkpoints at hand, so read each tensor's own extents rather than
+    # reusing q's.
+    tokens = q.shape[0] * q.shape[1]
+    num_q_heads, qk_dim = q.shape[2], q.shape[3]
+    num_v_heads, v_dim = v.shape[2], v.shape[3]
+    flashkda_fwd(
+        q=q.view(tokens, num_q_heads, qk_dim),
+        k=k.view(tokens, num_q_heads, qk_dim),
+        v=v.view(tokens, num_v_heads, v_dim),
+        g=g.view(tokens, num_v_heads, g.shape[3]),
+        beta=beta.view(tokens, num_q_heads),
+        A_log=A_log,
+        dt_bias=dt_bias,
+        out=out.view(tokens, num_v_heads, v_dim),
+        scale=scale,
+        lower_bound=lower_bound,
+        initial_state=initial_state,
+        final_state=final_state,
+        cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
+    )
+
+
+def decode_mtp(
+    *,
+    layer,
+    mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,
+    a: torch.Tensor,
+    b: torch.Tensor,
+    conv_states: torch.Tensor,
+    ssm_states: torch.Tensor,
+    intermediate_state_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    intermediate_conv_window_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    intermediate_state_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    cache_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,
+    replayssm_rawv: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    replayssm_rawk: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    replayssm_g: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    replayssm_beta: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """DSpark MTP / fused chain verify on PLA (direct g/beta layout)."""
+    from pla.decode import kda_mtp_sglang
+
+    seq_len = mixed_qkv.shape[0]
+    h = layer.num_v_heads
+    x_q, x_k, x_v = mixed_qkv.split([layer.q_dim, layer.k_dim, layer.v_dim], dim=-1)
+    x_q = x_q.reshape(1, seq_len, h, layer.head_q_dim)
+    x_k = x_k.reshape(1, seq_len, h, layer.head_k_dim)
+    x_v = x_v.reshape(1, seq_len, h, layer.head_v_dim)
+    w_q, w_k, w_v = layer.conv_weights.split(
+        [layer.q_dim, layer.k_dim, layer.v_dim], dim=0
+    )
+    cs_q, cs_k, cs_v = conv_states.split(
+        [layer.q_dim, layer.k_dim, layer.v_dim], dim=-1
+    )
+    cs_q = cs_q.transpose(-1, -2)
+    cs_k = cs_k.transpose(-1, -2)
+    cs_v = cs_v.transpose(-1, -2)
+    intermediate_conv_window_cache = intermediate_conv_window_cache.transpose(-1, -2)
+    ic_q, ic_k, ic_v = intermediate_conv_window_cache.split(
+        [layer.q_dim, layer.k_dim, layer.v_dim], dim=-2
+    )
+    # PLA keeps the gated RMSNorm inside the model: its interface takes the
+    # raw gate/beta layouts and has no norm parameters.
+    return kda_mtp_sglang.fused_kda_decode_mtp_dspark(
+        x_q=x_q,
+        x_k=x_k,
+        x_v=x_v,
+        w_q=w_q,
+        w_k=w_k,
+        w_v=w_v,
+        cs_q=cs_q,
+        cs_k=cs_k,
+        cs_v=cs_v,
+        g=a.view(1, seq_len, h, 128),
+        beta=b.view(1, seq_len, h),
+        A_log=layer.A_log.reshape(-1),
+        dt_bias=layer.dt_bias.reshape(-1),
+        recurrent_state=ssm_states,
+        intermediate_ssm=intermediate_state_cache,
+        intermediate_state_indices=intermediate_state_indices,
+        intermediate_conv_q=ic_q,
+        intermediate_conv_k=ic_k,
+        intermediate_conv_v=ic_v,
+        ssm_state_indices=cache_indices.to(torch.int32),
+        cu_seqlens=query_start_loc.to(torch.int32),
+        lower_bound=float(layer.lower_bound),
+        scale=layer.head_q_dim**-0.5,
+        replayssm_rawv=replayssm_rawv,
+        replayssm_rawk=replayssm_rawk,
+        replayssm_g=replayssm_g,
+        replayssm_beta=replayssm_beta,
+        onorm_gate=None,
+        onorm_weight=None,
+        onorm_eps=None,
+    )
+
